variants.role: current M16 Phoenix V3 productized runner route

pre_run_gates: M17 must obtain 2-AI review before any focused POD run.
The productized runner harness must exist and pass local dry-run/unit tests before POD.
The POD must pass the OptiX RT hardware gate on the same RTX 4000 Ada hardware class.
The K4 80,000-clique edge file must be generated once and checksummed before variants run.
All three variants must use the same edge file, same oracle, warmup=1, repeat=5, and separate output files.
The runner route must expose M16 metadata; otherwise the run is classified as harness failure, not performance evidence.
The runner process must print heartbeat output at least every 30 seconds.
No all-app run may be started from this protocol.

success_bars.productized_runtime: runner metadata must set runtime_executed=true, productized_execution_path=prepared_execution_session_runner, and runtime_trunk_executes_end_to_end=true
success_bars.material_set_a_candidate: runner OptiX must beat Embree same-contract control by at least 1.20x on both hot query median and runner-inclusive wall
success_bars.legacy_no_regression: runner-inclusive wall must be at least 0.98x of the legacy app-front-door OptiX route, or the result is productized coverage only and not the third strict Set-A material probe
success_bars.claim_boundary: all release/public/broad V3-over-V2/V4/zero-copy flags must remain false

failure_classification.no_runner_harness: stop and create/review M18 runner harness; do not spend POD
failure_classification.oracle_mismatch: stop; correctness failure, no performance interpretation
failure_classification.metadata_missing: classify as productized-runner failure, no Set-A credit
failure_classification.runner_slower_than_embree_or_below_1_20x: classify as coverage or negative evidence, no third strict Set-A credit
failure_classification.runner_regresses_vs_legacy_below_0_98x: classify as productized coverage only unless 2-AI accepts a specific justified exception

recommended_next_step.note: Because the current Triangle app CLI has no M16 productized runner mode, the conservative next step is to write and locally test the focused runner harness before any POD spend.

decision_audit.decision: write a protocol that exposes the missing runner harness as a pre-run gate instead of running POD from old Triangle numbers
decision_audit.foolish_actions: It would be foolish to reuse the old 347x/6.342x Triangle row as current Phoenix runner evidence or to run POD without a productized runner harness.
decision_audit.other_path: Authorize a focused POD run immediately because the POD is online. That risks measuring the old app route again and learning nothing about V3.
decision_audit.different_path_now: Freeze the exact row, controls, metrics, bars, harness gate, and resource cap; then seek 2-AI review before spending POD.
